title: Captador De Imóveis
description:
Oportunidade Confidencial – Parceiro Comercial em Captação de Imóveis

Estamos em busca de pessoas que queiram crescer junto com um projeto inovador no setor imobiliário. Se você tem energia comercial, gosta de desafios e sabe transformar conversas em oportunidades, essa vaga pode ser para você.

Nosso time de parceiros comerciais atua diretamente na promoção da nossa marca, buscando também trazer proprietários de imóveis para locação para dentro da nossa plataforma . É um papel estratégico, com alta autonomia, metas claras e estrutura para quem quer gerar impacto e ser reconhecido por performance.


Como será sua rotina

  • Atuar na prospecção ativa de imóveis residenciais para locação, por meio de diferentes canais (portais, redes sociais, ruas, indicações);
  • Estabelecer relacionamento com proprietários e apresentar, de forma consultiva, os diferenciais da nossa proposta;
  • Acompanhar o processo de captação até a ativação do imóvel na plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com metas mensais de captação e indicadores de performance;
  • Contornar objeções e conduzir negociações com segurança, empatia e foco no fechamento.


O que buscamos

  • Perfil comercial, resiliente e com alta capacidade de autogerenciamento;
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e habilidade em negociação;
  • Disposição paraabordagem ativa (ligações, mensagens e contato direto com proprietários);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de CRM;
  • Experiência anterior com captação de imóveis ou atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento domercado imobiliário local também é valorizado.


O que oferecemos

  • Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) ;
  • Ajuda de custo mensal e bonificações por desempenho ;
  • Modelo de trabalho com autonomia e flexibilidade de jornada ;
  • Não exigimos CRECI nem veículo próprio;
  • Suporte estruturado com Jornada de Conhecimento, ferramentas e acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Acesso a um projeto nacional em expansão, com possibilidade real de crescimento.


Nosso compromisso

Aqui, valorizamos quem entrega resultado. Você terá espaço para atuar com autonomia, apoio para evoluir e reconhecimento proporcional ao seu desempenho. Se você busca desafios e quer fazer parte da transformação do mercado imobiliário, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

title: Aws Devops Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.G., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Supervisor De Rov
description:
A Brunel, em parceria com um de seus grandes clientes de óleo e gas, está em busca de 10 Supervisores de ROV para atuar em operações offshore com ROV Work Class , em projetos de águas profundas e ultraprofundas.


Este é um grande projeto, sendo mobilizado atualmente e com previsão de início em Mar/2026, e é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais com forte base técnica em ROV e perfil de liderança, que desejam evoluir em um ambiente desafiador e de alta complexidade operacional.


Local de atuação: Bacia de Campos

Regime: Offshore - 14x14

Contrato: CLT por tempo indeterminado


Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar, operar e controlar sistemas de ROV Work Class (até 3000m) em operações offshore.
  • Atuar como referência técnica do time , garantindo o correto uso, manutenção e operacionalidade do ROV.
  • Liderar equipes de operadores e trainees, promovendo orientação técnica, treinamentos funcionais e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva (mecânica, elétrica, hidráulica, eletrônica e fibra óptica).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de procedimentos operacionais, requisitos contratuais e normas de segurança.
  • Atuar na mobilização e desmobilização de sistemas de ROV.
  • Elaborar e validar relatórios operacionais, boletins de serviço e registros técnicos.
  • Gerenciar situações críticas, tomadas de decisão sob pressão e eventuais conflitos a bordo.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das práticas de QSSMS / SMS , promovendo ambiente seguro e cultura de segurança.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com outras lideranças offshore, mantendo comunicação clara e eficiente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia com ROV Work Class (essencial).
  • Mínimo de 540 dias offshore em funções como Operador de ROV.
  • Ter realizado ao menos um embarque atuando como Supervisor de ROV , mesmo que de forma interina ou não oficial.
  • Vivência com ROVs como Magnun, Triton, Millennium (ou similares).
  • Formação técnica em Eletrônica, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas , com CREA ativo (obrigatório).
  • Experiência ou forte interface com área de manutenção .
  • Certificados CBSP e T-HUET válidos (NRs serão realizadas posteriormente).
  • Inglês nível intermediário para leitura técnica (manuais e documentação).
  • Perfil de liderança, boa comunicação, flexibilidade para atividades administrativas e capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia formal como Supervisor de ROV.
  • Inglês conversação.
  • Vivência em operações de águas profundas e ultraprofundas.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento ou adaptação de procedimentos operacionais.

title: Tech Lead - .Net E Angular
description:
Modelo de trabalho: híbrido 2x por semana no escritório

Localização: Escritório Central I Rio de Janeiro

Regime de contratação: CLT + benefícios



Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (.NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.

Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).

Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.


Principais responsabilidades:

Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias, realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy, gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).


Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Auxiliar De Paralegal/Societário
description:
O Grupo Ribeiro Brum iniciou suas atividades no ramo da contabilidade há mais de 26 anos e nesses anos acumulou experiências e networks necessários para apresentar soluções à instituições que facilitem a condução de seus negócios. Ao longo de sua trajetória agregou outras atividades correlacionadas como advocacia e imobiliária.

E queremos ter você em nossa história!


Responsabilidades

  • Coleta e verificação de documentos de empresas;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos societários, como estatutos, contratos sociais e atas de reuniões e realizar todo processo até o seu arquivamento (ou seja, processos de abertura, baixa e transformações de empresas e entidades do 3° setor);
  • Realizar registro e arquivamento de documentos junto aos órgão competentes;
  • Solicitações digitais, certidões e licenciamentos como alvarás e registros sanitários;
  • Acompanhar as modificações na legislação societária e garantir a conformidade da empresa;
  • Manter planilhas e controles internos atualizados;
  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente por canais digitais e presencial;
  • Reportar andamento das demandas ao gestor imediato.
  • Acompanhamento de parcelamentos;
  • Realizar o pedido de compra de Benefícios (Vale transporte / Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação);
  • Auxiliar em outras rotinas administrativas e demais rotinas do setor.


Pré-requisitos para a vaga

  • Graduação concluída ou em andamento nos cursos de: Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou similares.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara e objetiva;
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office;
  • Ser muito organizado e pró-ativo;
  • Residir próximoà Campo Grande-RJ.


Desejável: Experiência em execução de processos de abertura de empresas, alteração contratual e baixa de empresas e/ou demais áreas do paralegal.


Benefícios

  • Salário R$1.915,00;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • VA/VR;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub;
  • Day off de aniversário.


Informações adicionais

  • Local de Trabalho: Campo Grande-RJ (presencial).
  • Horário: Segunda à Quinta-feira das 8:00h às 18h00h e sexta-feira das 08:00h as 17:00h;

title: Gerente Imobiliário Comercial
description:
Gerente Comercial Imobiliário – Lopes Enjoy


A Lopes Enjoy busca um(a) Gerente Comercial Imobiliário Autônomo para atuar na liderança estratégica da equipe de corretores, com foco em resultados, desenvolvimento de pessoas e ampliação da performance das frentes de vendas (Avulsos e Lançamentos).


Sobre a Lopes Enjoy

Somos uma imobiliária integrante da rede Lopes, com presença consolidada em diversas regiões do Rio de Janeiro e atuação forte no mercado de médio e alto padrão. Trabalhamos com lançamentos, imóveis prontos e locação, oferecendo estrutura, tecnologia, carteira ativa e apoio contínuo ao desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais.


Responsabilidades da posição
  • Liderar, inspirar e desenvolver a equipe de corretores(as), garantindo constância nas rotinas comerciais.
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e impulsionar indicadores de performance: captação, atendimento, visitas, propostas, produção e conversão.
  • Atuar diretamente na estratégia de vendas, distribuindo o foco entre avulsos, locação e lançamentos conforme diretrizes da diretoria.
  • Garantir a integração e formação de novos corretores, promovendo cultura de alta performance e retenção.
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais, rituais de acompanhamento e feedbacks individuais.
  • Apoiar a geração de negócios por meio de campanhas, parcerias, presença digital e relacionamento com incorporadoras.
  • Trabalhar em alinhamento contínuo com diretoria e RH, reportando resultados e necessidades da operação.
  • Representar a unidade e promover ambiente colaborativo, organizado e orientado ao cliente.


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia como gestor(a) comercial imobiliário ou líder de equipes de corretores.
  • Vivência com lançamentos e/ou mercado de avulsos .
  • Perfil analítico com capacidade de leitura de indicadores e tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Habilidade em gestão de pessoas, motivação de equipe e desenvolvimento de talentos.
  • Proatividade para gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Boa comunicação, postura profissional e orientação intensa por resultados.
  • CRECI ativo (ou disponibilidade para regularização).


Diferenciais
  • Histórico de formação de equipes de alta performance.
  • Experiência em campanhas de captação de leads e presença digital.
  • Vivência com múltiplas frentes de receita (lançamentos, prontos e locação).


Local de Atuação

Unidades da Lopes Enjoy – com foco prioritário na região da zona sul e zona oeste, conforme estrutura.


Modelo de Atuação

Presencial, com dedicação integral à gestão comercial.

title: Tecnico(A) Implantação Ii
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.


Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.


Descritivo:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Implantação II para atuar na implantação, instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas e equipamentos técnicos , contribuindo diretamente para a execução de projetos em campo. O(a) profissional será responsável por realizar montagens, testes funcionais, integrações de sistemas e comissionamentos, garantindo o correto funcionamento das soluções implantadas.


Principais atividades:


  • Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, paineis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35).
  • Instalação e conexão de dispositivos de BMS, Security e SDAI tais como: cameras, sensores, detectores, atuadores, eletroímãs, leitores, módulos e outros dispositivos eletrônicos.
  • Conhecimento em montagem de RCE, montagem e organização de rack de cabeamento, instalação e conectorização de patch panel, switches e interligação de dispositivos de rede.
  • Leitura de diagramas, projetos de instalação e bayfaces.
  • Elaboração de relatório das atividades executadas em campo (RDO).
  • Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa.
  • Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em Qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
  • Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.


Habilidades:


  • Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira);
  • Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone e Terminais elétricos);
  • Instalação de Dispositivos eletrônicos de BMS, SDAI e SECURITY;
  • Montagem de Rede de cabeamento estruturado (RCE);
  • Diferenciais: Certificações de fabricantes de sistemas de BMS, SDAI, RCE e SECURITY.

title: Research Analyst
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

About BCP DTVM

BCP DTVM is a financial institution dedicated to the origination, structuring, and distribution of financial assets, with emphasis on private credit and structured operations. Our activities include an active trading desk in the secondary market, promoting liquidity and transparency for clients. Expanding from the offshore market to the local market, BCP DTVM combines technical expertise and agility, serving companies, institutional investors, and family offices with solid and innovative solutions. We are the right place for professionals seeking a dynamic, results-oriented environment, contributing to the future of the Brazilian financial market.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: full-time CLT

Position Description

We are looking for a Junior Research Analyst to join our Research team. The ideal candidate is analytical, curious, and highly motivated, and will support company- and sector-level analysis, as well as the preparation of financial reports and market studies.

Main Responsibilities


· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and monitor relevant economic and financial indicators.

· Prepare summaries and analyses on market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings forecasts.

· Monitor and analyze economic events, public policy changes, macroeconomic data, and other factors that may impact financial markets.

· Track financial asset movements.

· Assist in building and maintaining financial models for company valuation.

· Support senior analysts in data collection, organization, and analysis.

· Assist with the preparation of reports, presentations, and research materials.

· Collaborate in the development of materials for investor and market communications.


Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Solid understanding of core financial concepts, including financial statement analysis, valuation, and financial instruments.

· Familiarity with reading and interpreting financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

· Advanced Excel skills.

· Clear, precise, and objective writing skills.

· Strong communication skills to present and discuss analyses.

· Strong interest in financial markets, economic trends, and global events.

· Advanced to fluent English.

Differentials

· Certifications such as CPA-20.

· Previous experience in the financial market (internships or entry-level roles).

· Familiarity with platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

Benefits

· Competitive compensation.

· Professional growth opportunities in a company with strong presence in the fixed income market.

· A collaborative, dynamic, and high-performance work environment.

title: Project Engineer
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Project Engineer para atuar em projetos do setor de óleo & gás e energia, para uma empresa referência no setor.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar o Project Manager na coordenação e entrega de escopos específicos do projeto, liderando atividades técnicas, equipes e interfaces, assegurando o alinhamento aos objetivos do projeto, padrões de segurança, qualidade e desempenho.



Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, organizar, executar, controlar e reportar atividades e pacotes de trabalho sob sua responsabilidade, conforme diretrizes do Project Manager.
  • Coordenar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares, assegurando clareza de escopo, prazos, responsabilidades e objetivos do projeto.
  • Garantir comunicação eficaz entre stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo o fluxo adequado de informações para suporte à tomada de decisão.

  • Identificar riscos, apoiar a definição de ações de mitigação e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos e operacionais, garantindo o avanço das atividades conforme o plano do projeto.

  • Definir, implementar e monitorar planos de ação relacionados ao escopo sob sua responsabilidade.

  • Conhecimento sólido e experiência prática em gestão de projetos.
  • Conhecimento geral em disciplinas como HSE, planejamento, construção, qualidade, engenharia e suprimentos.
  • Experiência em gestão e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Vivência em projetos offshore no setor de óleo & gás, como Brownfield, EPC, Flotel, paradas programadas (shutdowns) e projetos de modificação/manutenção.
  • Experiência em projetos Brownfield será considerada um diferencial.
  • Certificação PMI ou pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos será um diferencial.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

Solid proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and basic project management tools.

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (Bsc/Rnc), Oss And Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.


Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.



Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript. Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures, including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*

  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

description:
VAGA NÍVEL: PLENO (PJ)

- Colaborar na elaboração, revisão e atualização do Plano Mestre de Validação, assegurando sua aderência às normas vigentes e às políticas internas da empresa.

- Suportar a gestão do ciclo de vida de qualificação e validação, incluindo equipamentos, utilidades, sistemas e infraestrutura.

Suporte técnico e melhoria contínua

- Apoiar tecnicamente as áreas de Engenharia, Produção, Garantia da Qualidade e Validação.

- Contribuir para a atualização de documentos técnicos e gestão de mudanças.

- Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de qualificação, propondo soluções baseadas em análise crítica de dados e tendências.

full-time Postdoctoral Research Associate Position will soon be available in the Laboratory of Dr. Sayan Nandi (PI), Howard University, Washington DC. The laboratory (funded by NIH and private foundation grants) is focused on understanding the contributions of microglial cells, the brain-resident macrophages (the principal immune cell type of the brain), toward various brain disorders. Thus, the work focus of the laboratory is at the interface of neuroscience and immunology. The laboratory integrates mouse genetic studies and cell culture model systems, to study the role of microglia, in the contexts of developmental and neuropsychiatric disorders (such as autism, schizophrenia), neurodegenerative diseases (such as Alzheimer’s disease, frontotemporal dementia), and neural injury (such as stroke, TBI).Microglia are the first amongst all macrophages to appear during early embryonic development. Recent studies have placed microglia in the landscape of sculpting and refining neural circuits due to their ability to modify synapses in live neurons, a phenomenon that has strong implications in neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases. These immune cells are also amongst the first responders following a neural injury. The laboratory undertakes multidisciplinary approaches such as biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, genomics, high-resolution imaging, neurophysiology, surgical, and behavioral studies. More information on Dr. Nandi’s research is available on: ACCOUNTABILITY:
The candidate is expected to have training in rodent procedures including but not limited to –stereotaxic methods (surgical), imaging, and behavioral studies. Experience in slice electrophysiology (or biochemistry/molecular biology) would be a plus but is not mandatory. The candidate is also expected to work collaboratively with the faculty in the Department of Anatomy, College of Medicine, as well as outside the Department, as required. The candidate should be able to effectively communicate with the PI. This position requires in-depth understanding of brain function and scientific literature, extensive data analysis and interpretation, as well as skills required for scientific presentation. The candidate is expected to be involved in the training of incoming students and postdoctoral fellows in the PI’s laboratory.NATURE AND SCOPE:
The candidate will have the opportunity to learn various models and relevant techniques in Neuroscience applicable to stroke and neurodegenerative diseases research, write competitive fellowship and grant applications and chalk out a pathway to independence. Internal and external contacts with a variety of researchers and faculty are anticipated.CORE COMPETENCIES:
Relevant technical skills and experience, Communication skills, Attention to details and Capability to work in a fast-paced environment.MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Ph. D. degree with background in Neuroscience or related fields.Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

PURPOSE:
The Howard University School of Social Work (HUSSW) is a leading institution of excellence in education, research, and service. Our graduate programs (MSW and Ph D) are rooted in our commitment to social justice and the advancement of quality of life for marginalized, vulnerable populations. The Ph D Program is a residential program offered on the campus of Howard University. Additionally, HUSSW offers the MSW curriculum through 2 distinct programs: Flagship and Starship. The Flagship Program is our residential program offered on the campus of Howard University. Our Starship program is offered online, both synchronously and asynchronously. Across the two MSW Programs, we serve approximately 400 MSW students. Sonographer
CLASSIFICATION:Hourly
HOURS OF WORK:Full Time, 4-day work week
DEPARTMENT:Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology
REPORTS TO:Lead Sonographer, Supervising Physician, Clinic ManagerWe seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging who is deeply committed to excellence in maternal-fetal health. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, family-focused environment and values the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes.This full-time position offers a four-day work week to support work-life balance while upholding the highest standards of care. Responsibilities include daily sonographic laboratory operations, equipment maintenance and performance, and continuous quality assessment of imaging services. The Perinatal Sonographer upholds strict adherence to Howard University FPP Privacy Policies as well as all applicable federal and state regulations governing healthcare practice and employment.ESSENTIAL DUTIES
Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered by the attending physician. Acquire and analyze data obtained using ultrasound and related diagnostic technologies. Meet examination components as defined by Maternal-Fetal Medicine Division, department procedures, established protocols, and AIUM’s examination guidelines.
Greet patients and guests, explain ultrasound procedures, prepare patients for appropriate examination according to department policies. Support patients and their families in a compassionate manner.
Verify accuracy of ultrasound requisition by checking physician orders.
Interview patients to gather history pertinent to the ultrasound examination.
Use independent judgment and systematic problem-solving methods to produce high quality diagnostic information and optimize patient care.
Conduct fetal exams including 1st trimester ultrasound, nuchal translucency measurement, 2nd trimester basic and detailed anatomic survey, 3rd trimester ultrasound, limited examinations, follow up examinations, transvaginal examinations, and biophysical profiles.
Assist perinatologists in invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
Provide summary findings to the physician to aid patient diagnosis and management. Prepare accurate and comprehensive preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system.
Collaborate closely with maternal-fetal medicine physicians, genetic counselors, nurses, and referring providers to ensure comprehensive care.
Perform portable examinations as requested.
Maintain equipment as instructed. Report equipment failures to the Lead Sonographer.
Perform daily pre-visit planning and assign related clerical duties as required.
Work in accordance with FPP and department policies regarding documentation and billing for ultrasound services.
Responsible for room preparation, stocking, clean-up, and equipment sterilization.
Assume responsibility for the safety and well-being of all patients in the sonographic area/department. Monitor, observe and recognize any abnormal changes in patients’ conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies with adequate handoff as needed. Obtaining assistance from physicians and other appropriate staff as needed.
Escort patients to a consultation room or waiting area upon completion of sonographic examination.
Coordinate with other staff to ensure appropriate patient care is provided.
Protect Personal Health Information (PHI) and maintaining compliance with Howard University FPP Privacy Policy. Use the minimum PHI necessary when completing assignments.
Adhere to infection control, safety procedures, and HIPAA compliance.
Promote, establish, and maintain open and effective communication with all members of FPP. Serves as a communication liaison between the physician and the patient.
Participate in continuing education and demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Receive, organize, prioritize, store, and maintain transmittable information utilizing electronic technology.
Perform other duties as defined by management or physicians.EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Require successful completion of an approved curriculum in diagnostic medical sonography or equivalent educational background.
Current registration (or Registry-eligible) by the American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
Prefer one-year prior OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic. New graduates are welcome to apply.
Basic Life Support and CPR certification are preferred.
Nuchal translucency certification through NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation. The ability to obtain certification within 6 months of employment is required if not currently certified.COMPETENCIES
Exceptional organizational and time management skills to ensure maximum productivity and efficiency.
Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to work with limited supervision while performing duties.
Meet national matrix standards to ensure the provision of high-quality patient care and diagnostic imaging services.WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS
This job is operated in a professional medical office environment. Requires the ability to work in a fast-paced environment under pressure and with a diverse population including staff, physicians, patients, family, and other members of the public on a regular basis. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. This position will have frequent exposure to contagious diseases; bodily fluids including blood; toxic substances; medicinal preparations and other conditions common to a clinical environment.Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Analista de reforma tributária sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Coordenador de implantação
description:
This position will be hired on an outsourcing basis, with an attractive salary and benefits package.
About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Deployment Coordinator to lead the execution phase of telecom infrastructure projects , ensuring that field activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and according to customer standards. This role requires daily presence with clients and subcontractors , close supervision of implementation teams, and strong alignment with internal project management and engineering areas. If you are passionate about execution, teamwork, and delivering excellence to top telecom operators, this position offers a high-impact opportunity within a global technology environment.
Key Responsibilities Coordinate the end-to-end execution of telecom deployment projects , from initial planning to final acceptance. Execute site inspections, surveys, and daily follow-ups to ensure alignment with technical and quality standards. Maintain direct face-to-face contact with customers , aligning priorities, reporting progress, and solving issues proactively. Manage subcontractors on a daily basis , monitoring performance, updating priorities, and escalating deviations when needed. Act as a technical coach and facilitator , ensuring subcontractor teams comply with internal, customer, and regulatory requirements. Prepare and deliver progress reports, documentation, and status updates according to internal and client procedures.
Ensure the fulfillment of safety, compliance, and quality prerequisites , including on-site and sample audits. Collaborate with project managers and engineering teams to align schedules, resources, and customer expectations.
Foster a culture of discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement among field teams.
Requirements Bachelor’s or Technical Degree in Telecom, Engineering, or related areas (mandatory). English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required ; Advanced Mandarin is desirable. 5+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry. 2+ years of experience in field coordination, supervision, or deployment operations. Proven ability to manage 10+ field teams simultaneously . Knowledge of wireless networks and telecom infrastructure ; Microwave and/or RAN experience is a strong plus. Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Solid proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Power Point, Outlook) and basic project management tools.
Desirable Qualifications MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management. Experience working in multicultural or Chinese corporate environments . Established relationships with major telecom operators (Claro, TIM, Vivo, Unifique, etc.).
Why Join Us Be part of a global telecommunications project that connects people, cities, and networks across Brazil and beyond. Work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment . Enjoy a competitive CLT package by EDC Manpower , benefits, and performance-based incentives. Build a meaningful career where execution excellence meets technological innovation .
If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Quality analyst
description:
About us:
DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.
About the job:
The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.
Audit & Compliance: Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC). Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer). Inspection Oversight:
Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). Non-Conformance Management: Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections. Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager. Documentation & Records:
Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function. Training & Communication:
Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.
Work Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.
Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.
Educational:
High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.
Technical Skills:
Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Soft Skills:
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.
Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.
Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Data analyst (azure)
description:
About You
You are a data-driven professional who enjoys transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business decisions. You thrive in client-facing environments, work comfortably with ambiguity, and take ownership of turning business questions into meaningful metrics, dashboards, and recommendations. You value data quality, storytelling, and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.
4–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence roles. Strong experience with Power BI for data visualization, dashboard design, and reporting. Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis. Advanced knowledge of SQL , including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization. Experience working with Azure and cloud-based data solutions. Ability to translate data into business-oriented insights, narratives, and recommendations.
Experience collaborating with stakeholders in fast-paced, client-facing environments.
Understanding of software development best practices and exposure to modern data platforms.
Excellent English communication skills, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Gather and analyze business requirements to define KPIs, metrics, and reporting needs.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver clear and actionable insights.
Collect and integrate data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, files, streams) into analysis-ready datasets.
Clean, validate, and prepare data by resolving inconsistencies, errors, and missing values.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Support predictive analysis and forecasting initiatives using statistical and machine learning techniques.
Ensure data quality, governance, and security standards are consistently met.
Communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports and presentations.
Qualifications
Tableau, Power BI and Qlik
Additional Information

title: General manager operations
description:
About the Company
Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about " Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.
Who we are:
We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.
With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.
About the job:
The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

title: Business development specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (Linked In, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients’ engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Engenheiro de reservatório
description:
A Aldelia é uma multinacional franco-inglesa com foco em soluções de RH e terceirização de serviços. Atuante em diversos mercados, principalmente no setor de Óleo e Gás.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Reservatório para atuar em contrato temporário de nossos grandes clientes do setor. Trata-se de uma posição para atuar no Rio de Janeiro - RJ em regime híbrido.
Atividades:
Integrar e validar dados de reservatório coletados (principalmente dados dinâmicos) às bases de dados de reservatórios, realizando sua interpretação e síntese para atualizar o entendimento do subsolo do campo.
Avaliar as principais incertezas do subsolo e seus impactos nas avaliações de reservas e nos perfis de produção.
Identificar revisões e atualizações necessárias dos modelos, contribuindo para a construção de novos modelos de reservatório e modificações (parte dinâmica), garantindo a adequação dos modelos e demais ferramentas para previsão de produção, avaliação de reservas e análise de incertezas.
Acompanhar estudos e projetos de geociências e reservatórios realizados na matriz, contribuindo com as trocas de dados necessárias.
Desenvolver competências em Engenharia de Reservatórios e Simulação, mantendo contato próximo com especialistas da afiliada e da matriz.
Garantir a integração com outras disciplinas de geociências e com integradores seniores de geociências, aplicando regras específicas da Companhia para proteção dos dados patrimoniais de geociências.
Responsabilidades:
Fornecer ferramentas e metodologias adequadas aos Ativos para influenciar o operador na gestão e desenvolvimento do campo.
Realizar as interpretações e estudos de síntese em engenharia de reservatórios necessários para melhorar o entendimento do subsolo e a previsibilidade dos modelos.
Participar da construção e atualização das bases de dados de subsolo da afiliada.
Requisitos:
Formação em Engenharia;
Experiência na função;
Inglês avançado;
Conhecimento em reservatórios do pré-sal;
Habilidade em Software de simulação de reservatórios (Eclipse/IX). Software de interpretação de reservatórios (suíte PETEX, Kappa Saphir, OFM...), e bases de dados de subsolo.

title: Fisioterapeuta de alto padrão
description:
Fisioterapeuta (Atendimento Humanizado e Padrão Hoteleiro) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ Sobre Nós:
Com uma trajetória consolidada de 15 anos de experiência direta (em um grupo com 25 anos de mercado), nossa atuação une o rigor técnico da saúde à excelência do atendimento hoteleiro. Somos referência em cuidados humanizados e de alto padrão. Buscamos profissionais que entendam que cuidar é uma arte que exige técnica, empatia e hospitalidade.
Descrição da Função:
Buscamos um(a) Fisioterapeuta para atuação em Rio de Janeiro (RJ), focado(a) no atendimento individualizado e humanizado. O profissional será responsável por:
Avaliação e Planejamento Terapêutico:  Realizar avaliações funcionais detalhadas e elaborar planos de tratamento fisioterapêutico personalizados, com foco na reabilitação e manutenção da capacidade funcional.
Reabilitação e Mobilidade:  Aplicar técnicas de fisioterapia motora e respiratória, visando a recuperação da mobilidade, força e independência do assistido.
Padrão de Excelência:  Integrar o tratamento técnico com a excelência do atendimento hoteleiro, garantindo um ambiente de cuidado seguro, organizado e acolhedor.
Monitoramento e Evolução:  Monitorar a evolução do quadro clínico, registrando progressos e ajustando o plano terapêutico em colaboração com a equipe multidisciplinar.
Ética e Hospitalidade:  Zelar pela discrição, ética e conforto do assistido e de sua família, mantendo uma comunicação clara e empática. O que buscamos (Requisitos):
Formação:  Graduação completa em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no CREFITO.
Experiência:  Experiência comprovada em reabilitação de idosos, pacientes neurológicos ou com necessidades especiais.
Diferencial:  Experiência prévia em setores de hospitalidade, hotelaria hospitalar, atendimento ao cliente de luxo ou em Fisioterapia Domiciliar (Home Care).
Perfil:  Postura profissional, pontualidade, excelente comunicação e forte senso de empatia e responsabilidade.
Localização:  Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou ter fácil acesso. Nossos Valores:
Priorizamos o compromisso, a responsabilidade e, acima de tudo, o respeito humano. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho profissional para quem deseja crescer com base na excelência e fazer a diferença na vida de nossos assistidos.
Como se Candidatar:
Envie seu currículo atualizado e carta de apresentação para (Seu E-mail de Recrutamento) com o assunto: Fisioterapeuta - RJ.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.
Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.
Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).
Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).
Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente Open Shift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).
Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Secretária
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados — e também resíduos.
Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor — e possível — continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.
Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .
Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.
Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.
Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Gerenciar agendas múltiplas de executivos, com foco em compromissos institucionais, reuniões internas e externas.

Antecipar necessidades, propor melhorias de fluxo e atuar de forma proativa no suporte à liderança.

description:

O profissional será responsável por apoiar o Project Manager na coordenação e entrega de escopos específicos do projeto, liderando atividades técnicas, equipes e interfaces, assegurando o alinhamento aos objetivos do projeto, padrões de segurança, qualidade e desempenho.

Planejar, organizar, executar, controlar e reportar atividades e pacotes de trabalho sob sua responsabilidade, conforme diretrizes do Project Manager.
Coordenar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares, assegurando clareza de escopo, prazos, responsabilidades e objetivos do projeto.
Garantir comunicação eficaz entre stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo o fluxo adequado de informações para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Desdobrar e comunicar os objetivos e metas do projeto à equipe, assegurando alinhamento e entendimento claro das prioridades.
Gerenciar interfaces técnicas e operacionais entre áreas como engenharia, planejamento, construção, suprimentos, qualidade e HSE.
Identificar riscos, apoiar a definição de ações de mitigação e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos e operacionais, garantindo o avanço das atividades conforme o plano do projeto.
Elaborar e apresentar relatórios periódicos de progresso, riscos, desvios e indicadores ao Project Manager.
Definir, implementar e monitorar planos de ação relacionados ao escopo sob sua responsabilidade.
Atuar, quando aplicável, como representante nominativo do projeto (internamente) e/ou da empresa (externamente) junto a clientes e parceiros.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês fluente.
Experiência mínima de 7 anos em funções similares, atuando em projetos.
Conhecimento sólido e experiência prática em gestão de projetos.
Conhecimento geral em disciplinas como HSE, planejamento, construção, qualidade, engenharia e suprimentos.
Experiência em gestão e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
Vivência em projetos offshore no setor de óleo & gás, como Brownfield, EPC, Flotel, paradas programadas (shutdowns) e projetos de modificação/manutenção.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Analista de inteligência de negócios sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;

Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;

Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.

Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
